ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && D=$(git diff --name-only "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD) && [ -n "$D" ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$D" | grep -qvE '^(apps/mobile|supabase|experiments)/'; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
